properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Raised by the bhome Session 2 report (2026-09-16, relayed by Anthony) after the loop closed: a 280 sq ft estimate measured at 288.9 off an IFC shell, written back, and budget_report saying "exceeded by 8, and all ten contributions are still estimated".

═══ WHAT THE REPORT FOUND ═══
(1) ⭐ THE SEAM EXISTED AND WAS NOT FOUND WHILE DESIGNING. `constrains` with `basis: measured` against a budget Constraint IS the partnership contract; the agent reasoned inside the relation vocabulary, drew no edge (correctly, for that vocabulary), and found the constructor afterwards with find_tools. Second instance of "an agent reasoning carefully inside the relation table does not discover a typed constructor" — the first was EVOLVES_INTO for promotions. (2) `subject: record` was "the only honest answer and it was obvious" for a measurement, and record_change's description does not say it is the common case for a measuring partner. (3) NO WORD FOR APPARATUS: the geometry model had to be a Component whose description disclaims its own type; cap:produce-build-package has sat unallocated for the same reason. (4) An authoritative artifact ("this file is the single source of truth for this geometry") had to be prose in a requirement. (5) SAVE CADENCE: ifc_render crashed the server and lost work added after the last save while the artifact was checksummed against the earlier file — "reflow2 knows when a file it tracks has drifted; it has no notion that an external tool holds unsaved state the file does not". (6) An accepted sequencing decision does not quiet the findings for its own deferred steps; each costs an acknowledgement.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ A HANDOFF SKILL ("make-it-in-the-tool" / cad-handoff), which is option A of the CAD-pairing idea made concrete by the report: the budget and its unit come from the graph; the tool measures; the number returns as a contribution with basis: measured (or a revised limit with subject: record), unit stated, measured_at stated, and the executor named; budget_report says whether it fits. Plus two sentences in `constrains` and `record_change` naming the case. Cheap; and the report says it would have made the whole partnership legible.
B. `Component.kind: apparatus` — one enum value, so a part can say "I am how this gets designed, not what gets designed", and allocation/modularity readings exclude it. Cheap. ⚠️ Counter: it is a Component still; the real thing is a tool, and dec:the-other-uaf-domains-wait-for-a-project-that-needs-them says materiel/resources wait for a project that needs them — this may be that project.
C. AN AUTHORITATIVE ARTIFACT: a property or edge saying this file is the source of truth for a geometry and these records derive from it. Moderate. Composes with the artifact-standard requirement built today (the standard's checker validates it).
D. A MEASURING INSTRUMENT: a Verification whose method is `measurement` and whose executor is a named external tool — "most of the way to closing the loop automatically". Largest; overlaps the provenance requirement's "measured (by which instrument)". ⚠️ Counter: reflow2 opens no file and calls no tool; the executor is named, never run, by reflow2.
E. LIVE-TOOL STATE: an Artifact flagged as produced by a live external tool, and set_artifact_checksum asking "saved?" — or at least the handoff skill saying save before every checksum. Cheap in the skill; the property is a judgement.
F. SEQUENCING QUIETS ITS STEPS: a capability SCHEDULED_FOR a planned epoch reads "not yet owed" in unrealized_capability rather than "unanswered" — the same shape as suppressed_by_parked_idea for defects. Moderate.

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
None of this makes the tool's number true. The IFC take-off was 26.84 m² off a model built on two assumptions, and the report said so; the vocabulary here is for saying where a number came from and what it is worth, which is exactly the provenance requirement, one seam over.
properties.name: OPEN — the reflow2↔tool partnership closed its first loop on bhome with vocabulary that already existed and nothing pointed at; does it need a NAMED contract (a handoff skill; `basis: measured` and `subject: record` said in the tools' own descriptions), a word for DESIGN APPARATUS, a way to say an artifact is authoritative and may be unsaved in a live tool, and a sequencing decision that quiets the findings for its own deferred steps?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill from a field report, nothing promoted. Kept as one question rather than six because every item is the same discovery: the partnership works with vocabulary that exists, and what is missing is the NAMING — of the contract, of the tool, of the file's authority, of the unsaved state. The A option is the same as the CAD-pairing idea's option A; recording it again here is deliberate, because the report supplies the evidence that idea lacked.
